title: Implement fib CLI in main.py
description: Implement the P0 feature from SPEC.md (Frozen 2026-09-09): replace the hello-world stub in main.py with a Fibonacci CLI. 'python main.py N' prints fib(N), 0-indexed (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1), for any non-negative integer N. Iterative O(n) loop, stdlib only (sys for argv), Python arbitrary-precision ints. stdout on success = bare decimal number + newline. Invalid input (missing arg, non-integer, negative) -> short usage/error on stderr, non-zero exit, nothing on stdout. Does NOT include: any file other than main.py, test files, packaging, README changes, fast-doubling or other algorithmic cleverness, sequence printing, nega-fib, third-party deps. Acceptance criteria are in ACCEPTANCE.md (identical numbering).
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'python main.py 0' prints '0' (single line on stdout) and exits 0
2. 'python main.py 1' prints '1' and exits 0
3. 'python main.py 10' prints '55' and exits 0
4. 'python main.py 100' prints '354224848179261915075' and exits 0
5. 'python main.py 1000' completes in under 2 seconds and prints exactly the 209-digit value 43466557686937456435688527675040625802564660517371780402481729089536555417949051890403879840079255169295922593080322634775209689623239873322471161642996440906533187938298969649928516003704476137795166849228875
6. For every valid input, stdout stripped of whitespace matches ^\d+$ (bare number, no extra text)
7. 'python main.py' (no argument) exits non-zero and prints a usage message to stderr
8. 'python main.py abc' exits non-zero, prints an error to stderr, and writes nothing to stdout
9. 'python main.py -5' exits non-zero, prints an error to stderr, and writes nothing to stdout
10. pyproject.toml still declares dependencies = [] (no third-party packages added)
close_reason: Prototyped and tested — solid. All 10 acceptance criteria verified: correct fib values for 0,1,10,100,1000; bare-number stdout format; proper stderr errors for missing/invalid/negative args; non-zero exits on error; zero deps preserved. ruff clean on main.py.
